summary:
IPS QR Code Payment feature on BookingPage confirmation screen fully verified. All 16 features tested and passed: QR section appears conditionally (bank_account exists AND total_price > 0), QRCodeSVG renders 220x220px on white background with rounded corners, section title 'Brzo plaćanje (IPS QR kod)' with QrCode icon in amber (#C5A880), instruction text about mBanking scanning, account number in XXX-XXXXXXXXXXXXX-XX format, amount in RSD format with comma (RSD2000,00), reference as 99+bookingID, all fallback text rows have min-height 48px. IPS QR string format verified: uses 
 delimiters, starts with K:PR
V:01
C:1, contains R: with 18-digit account, I: with RSD comma format, SF:289, RO: with 99+bookingID. Serbian transliteration verified: č/ć→C, š→S, ž→Z, đ→Dj, all uppercase. Full booking flow works end-to-end.
